info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Arsenat Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Arsenat Produce Detail Management API allows users to efficiently manage and enrich the catalog of Arsenat produce details. This API facilitates the submission of detailed information about various produce, empowering businesses to ensure their catalogs are up-to-date and comprehensive. Typical consumers include inventory managers, agricultural suppliers, and e-commerce platforms that require accurate product information. This operation supports the enhancement of product listings, driving better sales and customer satisfaction through improved visibility of Arsenat produce.

post.summary: Create a new arsenat produce detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail for arsenat produce. Users can submit the necessary information through a POST request and receive a response indicating the success of the operation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the arsenat production operation. It requires a JSON object that contains specific properties and values necessary for processing the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully; responsive data returned.

CreateCatalogArsenatProduceDetailRequest.title: Arsenat Produce Request Body

arsenat_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the Arsenat produce item.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the Arsenat produce.

quantity.description: The quantity of Arsenat produce requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Arsenat produce.

CreateCatalogArsenatProduceDetailRequest.description: This schema defines the request body for creating a new Arsenat produce entry.
